notes.title: Early Access 1.1.1 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Migrated to Unreal Engine 5.2.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where only one of the two soundtracks would play on the main menu.
[*] Fixed issue with Word Search Puzzle win conditions.
[*] Fixed Slide Puzzle preview image. You can now press Tab to preview the correct pattern.
[*] Fixed issue where torch lighting wouldn’t render properly.
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
[h3]To be fixed in a future update.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Light bleeding through ceilings.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]New:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added adjustable mouse sensitivity as well as options to invert mouse x & y axes.
[*] Suggestions which remind you of the hint hotkey are displayed when entering puzzles and hiding places. This can be disabled in Display Settings by unchecking “Display Suggestions”.
[/olist]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted controls to be more intuitive.
[*] Slide puzzle is generated instantly instead of during gameplay as well as adjusted puzzle piece selection.
[*] Replaced some fonts to be more readable.
[*] Minor UI changes.
[/olist]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Selected settings are now displayed in red text, indicating which category of settings you are in / which difficulty is currently selected.
[/olist]
